name: Subliminal sine sub
desc: Deep pumping sine sub walking an Am i-VI-VII/v progression over 8 cycles; felt more than heard, with a slow 32-cycle filter breath. Harvested from the autopilot dub scene's sine bass, moved to A minor and given long-form motion.

code.peak: stack(note("<a1 a1 f1 <g1 e1>>").struct("x*8").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.005).decay(.15).sustain(.35).release(.06).lpf(${cut}).shape(.25).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55,${gain}).fast(4)),note("<a2 a2 f2 <g2 e2>>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ [x x]").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").decay(.12).sustain(.2).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*2.2).slow(16)).gain(${gain}*.4).iter(4)).orbit(3).play()
